start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher hoon. Aaj perimeter padhenge. Aapko rectangles ya squares mein kya interesting lagta hai?

turns.line: rectangle ke chaaron sides jodenge, 50 plus 30 plus 50 plus 30, 160 metre
turns.reply: Kabir, aapne chaaron sides jodkar sahi method lagaya; 50 plus 30 plus 50 plus 30, yani 160 metre. Square mein kya karenge?
Kabir, rectangle ka perimeter 160 metre hai. Kisi bhi polygon mein sabhi sides jodiye. Agar sides 5, 4, 3 metre hon, perimeter kitna hoga?
